authority.source: UrAi Generic World Library governed modular specification; generic exploration candidate

prompt: Original generic modular architecture-shell; one separable asset, not a whole environment. No real place/person, brands, logos, visible text, sci-fi, low-poly filler, floating parts or intersecting geometry. Physically plausible PBR, believable wear, correct UVs/normals; meter scale, +Y up, reusable grounded pivot. Two rectangular spaces with a 1.4 m connection and clear exit. No secure-site plans, real launch controls, classified labels, or authentic restricted equipment layouts. Target bounding dimensions 9m wide x 2.9m high x 7m deep. Materials: paint-institutional-soft. Clear passage where applicable; no arms/hands, forced characters or inaccessible hazards. GLB with embedded PBR textures. Generic exploration candidate only; visual/rights review required.
